# !KEEP LIST!
# nullaoparticles.txt — extra paths this toggle leaves untouched, added on top of the built-in list.
# One rule per line. Bare = "contains" match, * = wildcard, # = comment.
#
# Examples (uncomment and adapt):
#   metadata/effects/spells/lightning/      # keep a whole folder
#   *herald*                                # keep anything containing "herald"
#   metadata/effects/spells/fire/meteor.ao  # keep one exact file (full path)
#
